questions.q: Sort each statement by the kind of connection it describes.
items: Lets a device be moved around freely
Signal can be weakened by walls and distance
Harder for someone outside the building to intercept
Needs no cable to be run to each device
Less affected by other devices nearby
questions.feedback: Wired wins on speed, reliability and security; wireless wins on convenience.
questions.revisitLabel: 1.3 Lesson 9 — Connection café, station 5: Wired vs wireless

questions.q: Why is Bluetooth used for a wireless keyboard rather than Wi-Fi?
options: It uses very little power and is designed for short-range links between two devices
It has much higher bandwidth than Wi-Fi
It works over a much longer range than Wi-Fi
It encrypts data and Wi-Fi does not
questions.feedback: Bluetooth is for short range and low power. Wi-Fi is faster and reaches further, and both can be encrypted.

questions.q: A library is installing a network for visitors' laptops and its own catalogue computers. Recommend a connection type for each, and justify your choices.

markPoints.concept: because visitors move around and cannot be cabled in
markPoints.exemplar: Visitors sit wherever they like, so they cannot be cabled in.
Wired Ethernet for the catalogue computers.

markPoints.concept: because they stay in one place and need a fast, reliable and more secure connection
markPoints.exemplar: They never move, and a wired link is faster, more reliable and harder to intercept.

questions.example: The visitors' laptops should use Wi-Fi, because visitors sit wherever they like and cannot be cabled in. The catalogue computers should be wired with Ethernet: they stay in one place, so running a cable is easy, and a wired connection is faster, more reliable and harder for anybody to intercept.
questions.paraphrase: Give the public wireless access, since they move about the building and could not be plugged in anywhere useful. Put the library's own terminals on cable, as they are fixed in position and benefit from the greater speed, stability and security.
questions.feedback: Two recommendations and a reason for each. A reason that could apply to either one is not really a justification.
